headline: Mnet, Bandai Namco team up for virtual idol survival show
sub: A new virtual boy group set to be formed, airing in 2028
source: Source: Official announcement from Mnet (via Korean media)
caption:
Mnet is making its next survival show for virtual idols.

The channel behind I-LAND and the Planet series announced on Nov 27 that it is teaming up with Japan's Bandai Namco Entertainment (THE IDOLM@STER) on a virtual boy group survival show, working title 'Virtual Idol Survival'. Virtual characters will compete with their own voices, music and performances for a debut spot. Characters are still in development, and the show is aiming for 2028. Mnet called it "a meaningful attempt" to bring K-pop survival's story of challenge and growth into the virtual world.
